notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Potosi-specific source (Central US Lookouts), which quotes an annual report for the 80-acre acquisition. Its page header names the Missouri Conservation Commission while the report it quotes names the Missouri Department of Conservation; both names are kept as written. The fiscal year 1949-50 is recorded as year 1949. Checked without finding Potosi detail: the Potosi city article on Wikipedia does not mention a tower; Natural Atlas and TopoZone list a Potosi Lookout Tower only as a map point, so they are not cited; a Facebook post about the Perryville district map seen in search is not about Potosi and was not fetched. No status, access, height, design or construction date was found. The record's location and 377 m elevation come from OSM and were not verified here. Next step: ask MDC or Washington County whether a tower stands on the 80-acre tract, and whether the public can visit.
